title: Multi-Granularity Cross-modal Alignment for Generalized Medical Visual Representation Learning
layout_note: Real chest X-rays (top left) feed the image encoder bar; reports and words (bottom left) feed the text encoder bar; between and beside them three alignment modules in tinted regions (token-wise, instance-wise matrix, prototype clustering).
grouping: Each alignment module is a tinted rounded region titled with its coloured abbreviation; the abbreviations are expanded in a dashed key box at the bottom right.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded bars for the encoders (green image, purple text), embeddings as coloured cell columns, a similarity matrix with blue positives.
proposed_highlight: The three granularities are the three tinted regions, each named by a coloured abbreviation.
lesson: Colour the image path green and the text path purple all the way through, and give each alignment objective its own tinted region with its own abbreviation.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue NeurIPS 2022 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15).

arrangement.units: three tinted regions, one per alignment objective, between and right of the encoder bars
arrangement.inputs_as: real X-ray thumbnails and quoted report lines and words
arrangement.losses_at: each objective in its own tinted region where the two modalities meet

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the green Image Encoder (top) and purple Text Encoder (bottom) feed three tinted objective regions at three granularities - yellow token-level CTA between the encoders, pink instance-level ITA similarity matrix, blue prototype-level CPA clustering at the far right

relations.form: green lines from the image representation column and purple lines from the text representation column each branch to both the pink ITA box and the blue CPA panel, while dashed callouts pull token embeddings R_i and Z_i into the yellow CTA region
the ITA box draws a 4 x 4 similarity matrix with green image squares across the top, purple text squares down the left and blue diagonal cells
the CPA panel draws two partitioned embedding spaces (image above, text below) with squares, crosses and circles in cells around prototypes, linked by green and purple 'Cross-modal prediction' arrows

inside the CTA region two Cross Attention blocks take Key/Value from one modality's token row and Query from the other via elbow lines, with curved black 'Align' arrows tying the attended rows back to the original token rows
left to right from inputs (real chest X-rays with zoomed patch circles; quoted report lines split into word chips) to the encoders, to vertical representation columns v_i and t_i, to the objectives

channels.colour: green = image side, purple = text side (encoders, lines, representation columns, query/key arrows); region tint = objective (yellow CTA, pink ITA, blue CPA), keyed in a dashed legend; multicolour cells = token embeddings, and blue also fills the ITA diagonal
channels.shape: vertical square columns = global representations; multicolour cell rows = token embeddings; squares/crosses/circles = cluster members; dark rounded bars = encoders
channels.line: solid lines = data flow; dashed lines = callouts to token embeddings; curved black arrows = alignment
channels.frame: tinted rounded region = one alignment objective; dashed rounded outline = a representation pulled out

quality.strengths: modality is one colour everywhere (green image, purple text), the compared representations are drawn as square columns and token rows between encoders and objectives, the ITA is a real matrix and the CPA is a drawn clustering, and each objective has its own tinted region keyed at the bottom right
quality.weaknesses: the CTA region sits between the encoders and dominates the centre although token-level alignment is one of three objectives; the multicolour token cells reuse the blue of the CPA tint and ITA diagonal; the encoder outputs travel long elbow lines from the left edge past CTA to reach ITA and CPA

insights.structure: Green Image Encoder bar on top and purple Text Encoder bar at the bottom, with three tinted regions for the objectives: yellow CTA between the encoders, pink ITA similarity matrix to the right, blue CPA prototype-clustering panel at the far right.
insights.data: Inputs are real chest X-rays with zoomed patch circles and quoted report lines split into word chips; representations are vertical columns of green or purple squares, token embeddings are multi-coloured cell rows, and the ITA is a 4 x 4 grid with blue diagonal cells.
insights.emphasis: Each alignment objective gets its own tinted region with its acronym in a matching colour (CTA orange, ITA red, CPA blue), explained in a dashed key at bottom right.
insights.flow: Left to right from inputs to encoders to representation columns; green lines run from the image side and purple lines from the text side into each objective, with curved black 'Align' arrows inside CTA.
insights.avoid: The purple 'Query' lines in CTA loop around the cross-attention boxes and cross the green ones, making the token-wise alignment hard to trace.
